autosprite.prompt_summary: Back-view-only SD Nekuring companion strike: preserve purple hooded cloak, skull ring halo, skull-topped staff, glowing purple soul core on back, and gold trim; no face/front body/camera spin; staff windup, ghostly purple crescent impact, recoil, and return.

runtime_sheet.frame_interval: one-shot strike; compatible with lingpet_companion_sprite_animator.gd 5x5 frame math

postprocess.tool: Pillow AutoSprite-derived frame remap and alpha dust cleanup
postprocess.note: The raw AutoSprite strike was visually accepted but placed the impact before the runtime 18-24 strike window. The final sheet preserves AutoSprite source frames, remaps the staff windup / crescent impact / recoil into frames 18-24, skips edge-touching source frames, and clips alpha <= 8.

notes: Gameplay-scale preview matches existing Nekuring idle and move body class at companion_strike_draw_size 92.0.
Attack branch keeps a rear or rear-three-quarter read and preserves the skull ring halo, purple hood, skull staff, back soul core, and gold trim.
The accepted runtime window uses frames 18-24 so anticipatory contact starts land on staff draw and impact reaches frame 22.
